warning: Not a fresh independent holdout and not final ground truth. Labels were revised through a review process and require independent human/domain validation.

cases.claim: The city’s new bike lanes reduced car traffic downtown.
cases.evidence: After protected cycling lanes opened, downtown vehicle counts fell by 12%.
cases.rationale: Downtown vehicle counts fell by 12% after protected bike lanes opened. The before-and-after association alone does not establish that the bike lanes caused the reduction.

cases.claim: The city’s new bike lanes reduced car traffic downtown.
cases.evidence: Cycling-lane construction finished in June, and downtown vehicle counts were measured in July.
cases.rationale: The evidence gives timing but no direction of traffic change or causal evidence.

cases.claim: Remote work improved employee satisfaction.
cases.evidence: Employees working from home reported higher satisfaction scores than before the policy.
cases.rationale: Higher satisfaction scores among remote workers match the claimed outcome.

cases.claim: Remote work improved employee satisfaction.
cases.evidence: Employees said they liked the flexibility of remote work.
cases.rationale: Positive comments about flexibility do not establish an overall satisfaction improvement.

cases.claim: The new tutoring program helped students learn mathematics.
cases.evidence: Students enrolled in the tutoring program achieved higher mathematics test scores than their previous scores.
cases.rationale: Before-and-after score improvement alone does not establish that the tutoring program caused the improvement.

cases.claim: The new tutoring program helped students learn mathematics.
cases.evidence: The tutoring program was offered to students who were already struggling in mathematics.
cases.rationale: The evidence describes program eligibility or recipients, not learning outcomes.

cases.claim: The medication shortened recovery time.
cases.evidence: Patients receiving the medication recovered in fewer days on average.
cases.rationale: Fewer recovery days directly match shorter recovery time.

cases.claim: The medication shortened recovery time.
cases.evidence: Most patients recovered after taking the medication.
cases.rationale: Recovery after medication does not show that recovery was faster.

cases.claim: The policy lowered household energy use.
cases.evidence: Average household electricity consumption was lower after the policy began.
cases.rationale: Average household electricity consumption was lower after the policy began. The temporal association alone does not establish that the policy caused the reduction.

cases.claim: The policy lowered household energy use.
cases.evidence: The policy was designed to encourage households to conserve electricity.
cases.rationale: The policy's stated aim does not demonstrate an actual reduction in energy use.

cases.claim: Daily exercise prevents depression.
cases.evidence: People who exercised daily had lower rates of depression in an observational survey.
cases.rationale: An observational association does not establish that exercise prevents depression.

cases.claim: The new app caused workers to become more productive.
cases.evidence: Workers using the app completed more tasks, but the study did not control for prior productivity.
cases.rationale: Prior productivity was not controlled, leaving alternative explanations.

cases.claim: Eating breakfast increases exam scores.
cases.evidence: Students who ate breakfast scored higher, although breakfast habits were not randomly assigned.
cases.rationale: The observational comparison does not establish that breakfast caused higher exam scores.

cases.claim: The factory closure reduced local asthma cases.
cases.evidence: Asthma cases declined after the factory closed, and investigators attributed the decline to reduced emissions.
cases.rationale: Investigators explicitly attributed the decline in asthma cases to reduced emissions after the factory closure. Retained provisionally; the attribution method and strength are not specified.

cases.claim: Social media use causes anxiety in teenagers.
cases.evidence: A survey found that teenagers with higher social media use also reported more anxiety.
cases.rationale: Correlation alone does not establish causation.

cases.claim: The training course improved sales.
cases.evidence: Sales rose during the quarter in which the course was introduced, while advertising spending also increased substantially.
cases.rationale: Advertising spending also increased, so the course's independent effect is unclear.

cases.claim: Installing insulation lowered heating costs.
cases.evidence: A controlled comparison found homes with the new insulation used less heating energy than similar homes without it.
cases.rationale: A controlled comparison of similar homes supports lower heating energy use with insulation.

cases.claim: The tax increase caused restaurant closures.
cases.evidence: Several restaurants closed after the tax increase, but the report did not examine why they closed.
cases.rationale: Temporal sequence alone does not establish causation.

cases.claim: The project reduced costs by 20%.
cases.evidence: The audited report found that project costs fell by 20% compared with the previous year.
cases.rationale: The 20% decrease matches the stated comparison.

cases.claim: The project reduced costs by 20%.
cases.evidence: The audited report found that project costs fell by 12% compared with the previous year.
cases.rationale: The evidence reports a 12% decrease rather than 20%.

cases.claim: The town’s population reached 50,000 in 2024.
cases.evidence: The census recorded 50,000 residents in the town in 2024.
cases.rationale: Population, value, location, and year match.

cases.claim: The town’s population reached 50,000 in 2024.
cases.evidence: The census recorded 50,000 residents in the town in 2022.
cases.rationale: The evidence refers to 2022, not 2024.

cases.claim: The battery lasts 10 hours on one charge.
cases.evidence: In the standardized test, the battery lasted 8 hours on one charge.
cases.rationale: The standardized test reports 8 hours rather than 10.

cases.claim: The battery lasts 10 hours on one charge.
cases.evidence: The battery was tested at 10 hours of continuous video playback.
cases.rationale: A 10-hour test duration does not establish 10 hours of actual battery runtime.

cases.claim: Revenue increased from $2 million to $3 million.
cases.evidence: Annual revenue rose from $2 million to $3 million.
cases.rationale: The revenue values match: $2 million to $3 million.

cases.claim: Revenue increased from $2 million to $3 million.
cases.evidence: Annual revenue rose from $2 million to $2.5 million.
cases.rationale: The evidence reports $2.5 million rather than $3 million.

cases.claim: The trial found that the treatment reduced pain.
cases.evidence: The trial found no meaningful reduction in pain compared with placebo.
cases.rationale: Evidence reports no meaningful reduction, contrary to the claim.

cases.claim: The trial found that the treatment reduced pain.
cases.evidence: The trial found a meaningful reduction in pain compared with placebo.
cases.rationale: Evidence directly reports a meaningful reduction in pain.

cases.claim: The company did not miss its delivery target.
cases.evidence: The company missed its delivery target by two days.
cases.rationale: Evidence says the company missed its delivery target.

cases.claim: The company did not miss its delivery target.
cases.evidence: The company delivered all orders within the target window.
cases.rationale: All orders arrived within the target window.

cases.claim: The update did not fix the security vulnerability.
cases.evidence: The vulnerability remained exploitable after the update.
cases.rationale: The vulnerability remained exploitable after the update.

cases.claim: The update did not fix the security vulnerability.
cases.evidence: Testing confirmed that the update eliminated the vulnerability.
cases.rationale: Evidence says the update eliminated the vulnerability.

cases.claim: The school’s absence rate did not increase.
cases.evidence: The absence rate stayed at 4% in both terms.
cases.rationale: The unchanged 4% absence rate supports no increase.

cases.claim: The school’s absence rate did not increase.
cases.evidence: The absence rate rose from 4% to 6%.
cases.rationale: The absence rate increased from 4% to 6%.

cases.claim: The program improved outcomes for adults over 65.
cases.evidence: Among adults aged 18–30, completion rates improved after the program.
cases.rationale: Evidence concerns ages 18-30, not adults over 65.

cases.claim: The program improved outcomes for adults over 65.
cases.evidence: Among adults aged 65 and older, completion rates improved after the program.
cases.rationale: The evidence measures completion rates among adults aged 65+, while the claim concerns broader outcomes. The measured metric does not establish the broader claim.

cases.claim: The policy increased employment in rural areas.
cases.evidence: Urban employment rose by 3% after the policy began.
cases.rationale: Urban employment data does not establish rural employment.

cases.claim: The policy increased employment in rural areas.
cases.evidence: Rural employment fell by 3% after the policy began.
cases.rationale: Rural employment fell by 3%, opposite to the claimed increase.

cases.claim: The supplement improved sleep quality.
cases.evidence: Participants reported better sleep quality after using the supplement.
cases.rationale: Participants reported better sleep quality, matching the claimed outcome.

cases.claim: The supplement improved sleep quality.
cases.evidence: Participants reported falling asleep faster, but overall sleep quality was not measured.
cases.rationale: Falling asleep faster is related to, but not equivalent to, overall sleep quality.

cases.claim: The redesign increased customer retention.
cases.evidence: The redesign increased the number of first-time purchases.
cases.rationale: First-time purchases measure acquisition, not retention.

cases.claim: The redesign increased customer retention.
cases.evidence: The share of customers returning within 90 days increased after the redesign.
cases.rationale: The share of customers returning within 90 days increased, directly supporting improved retention.

cases.claim: The device works reliably in all weather conditions.
cases.evidence: The device operates reliably in dry weather, but its performance in rain was not tested.
cases.rationale: Dry-weather performance does not establish all-weather reliability.

cases.claim: The device works reliably in all weather conditions.
cases.evidence: The device failed during heavy rain testing.
cases.rationale: Failure during heavy rain conflicts with reliable operation in all weather conditions.

cases.claim: The benefit applies to every applicant.
cases.evidence: Applicants receive the benefit only if their income is below the eligibility threshold.
cases.rationale: The benefit has an income eligibility condition, so it does not apply to every applicant.

cases.claim: The benefit applies to eligible low-income applicants.
cases.evidence: Applicants receive the benefit only if their income is below the eligibility threshold and other criteria are met.
cases.rationale: Eligibility conditions do not establish that an applicant actually applied or that every eligible applicant received the benefit.

cases.claim: The treatment is effective regardless of age.
cases.evidence: The treatment was effective in adults, but effectiveness in children remains unknown.
cases.rationale: Adult effectiveness does not establish effectiveness in children.

cases.claim: The service is available every day.
cases.evidence: The service is available on weekdays only.
cases.rationale: Weekday-only availability conflicts with availability every day.

cases.claim: The intervention dramatically improved test scores.
cases.evidence: Average test scores increased slightly after the intervention.
cases.rationale: A slight increase does not match the claim of a dramatic improvement.

cases.claim: The intervention slightly improved test scores.
cases.evidence: Average test scores increased modestly after the intervention.
cases.rationale: A modest increase is consistent with a slight improvement.

cases.claim: The product substantially reduced noise.
cases.evidence: Noise levels fell by 1% in the measured room.
cases.rationale: A 1% reduction appears inconsistent with 'substantially reduced'.

cases.claim: The product slightly reduced noise.
cases.evidence: Measured noise levels fell by 1%.
cases.rationale: A measured 1% reduction matches the claim of a slight reduction.

cases.claim: The campaign greatly increased awareness.
cases.evidence: Surveyed awareness rose from 40% to 42%.
cases.rationale: An increase from 40% to 42% does not ordinarily support 'greatly increased'.

cases.claim: The campaign significantly increased awareness.
cases.evidence: Surveyed awareness rose from 40% to 65%.
cases.rationale: The increase from 40% to 65% is measurable, but the evidence does not establish statistical significance. This decision interprets 'significantly' in the statistical sense.

cases.claim: The new park reduced neighborhood crime.
cases.evidence: The city spent $2 million building the new park.
cases.rationale: Construction spending provides context but does not establish a reduction in neighborhood crime.

cases.claim: The new park reduced neighborhood crime.
cases.evidence: Residents reported that the park is attractive and well maintained.
cases.rationale: Positive comments about appearance and maintenance do not establish crime outcomes.

cases.claim: The school lunch program improved attendance.
cases.evidence: The school lunch program served 12,000 meals last month.
cases.rationale: Meal counts measure program activity, not whether attendance improved.

cases.claim: The school lunch program improved attendance.
cases.evidence: Attendance increased from 88% to 93% after the lunch program began, with no other explanation provided.
cases.rationale: Attendance rose after the program, but causation is not established.

cases.claim: The new filter makes drinking water safer.
cases.evidence: The filter's packaging uses recyclable materials.
cases.rationale: Recyclable packaging does not establish drinking-water safety.

cases.claim: The new filter makes drinking water safer.
cases.evidence: Independent tests found that the filter removed 95% of the tested contaminant from water.
cases.rationale: The test establishes removal of 95% of one tested contaminant, not that the water is broadly safer across relevant contaminants.
